headline: Abu Dhabi's MBZUAI and the company Inception42 have launched Jais 3, a set of six open Arabic AI language models plus an Arabic speech recognition model.
score_reason: Notable regional open model release; benchmark leadership claims come from the developers.
importance_line: Arabic speakers and organisations in the UAE and beyond get open models trained on spoken dialects, but the leadership claims come from the developers' own benchmarks.
summary: Gulf News reports that the Institute of Foundation Models at Mohamed bin Zayed University of Artificial Intelligence (MBZUAI) and the company Inception42 have introduced Jais 3, six open language models from 900 million to 375 billion parameters, plus Jais Speech, which transcribes Arabic dialects from 19 Arab countries. The developers say, from their own tests on 24 Arabic benchmarks, that the largest model leads open models on agent tasks, and the models are free on Hugging Face.
notes: WAM page returned no text; read Gulf News carrying the same announcement (also on WAM and PR Newswire). benchmark claims are the developers'.
